name: contremaitre
description: Configure isolated application stacks, verify changes and share previews with Contremaitre

interface.shortDescription: Configure stacks, run checks and share previews.
interface.longDescription: Set up workspace environments, run project verification and manage public preview sessions through the Contremaitre CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use $contremaitre to test this workspace and report its preview and verification results.
Use $contremaitre-setup to configure this application for isolated local development.
Use $contremaitre-share to share this application with a live public preview.
